dataset_or_layer: NHDPlus HR vector hydrography bundle (NHDFlowline; NHDPlusCatchment; NHDPlusFlowlineVAA; NHDWaterbody; WBD HU8/HU12)
role_in_swatgenx: Primary routed network; catchment polygons; lake polygons; VAA attributes; hydrologic unit labels for clipping and reporting
native_resolution_or_scale: High-resolution vector product family (commonly cited as ~1:24 000-scale linework where published at that resolution)
processed_resolution_or_use: Projected UTM per VPU; metric lengths/areas for SWAT+ exports
acquisition_or_storage_mode: HTTPS listing under USGS staged hydrography; GDB unpack to working VPU tree; per-VPU pickles before model-scale clip
preprocessing_summary: Per-VPU download and extract; topology cleaning and hydrologic-sequence harmonization before HUC12 clip (see documents/NHDPlus_HR_SWATPlus_Methods.md and documents/SWATGenX/README_NHDPlus_HR_SWATPlus.md)
notes: Record the USGS listing access date and the exact GDB/raster filenames used for each evaluated VPU at submission time.

dataset_or_layer: NHDPlus HR bundled elevation raster (elev_cm and related HR DEM products)
role_in_swatgenx: Reach elevation extrema for channel drop; aligned terrain grid for SWAT+ GIS stack
native_resolution_or_scale: Native HR DEM posting is product/stage dependent (source elev_cm in centimeters in the documented pipeline)
processed_resolution_or_use: Resampled to 30 m bilinear and reprojected to preprocessed stream CRS; written as USGS_DEM_30m.tif in the documented naming convention
acquisition_or_storage_mode: Packaged HR raster branch download (zip/7z) under operator cache; not a persistent public archive of every generated DEM tile by default
preprocessing_summary: Download/unpack; align to streams pickle CRS; skip if stream pickle missing (see README §7)
notes: Large intermediate rasters are operator-local; manuscript should not imply long-term archival of every DEM artifact.

dataset_or_layer: Watershed Boundary Dataset (WBD) HU8 and HU12 polygons
role_in_swatgenx: Administrative hydrologic unit labels; multipart handling; UTM zone selection anchor (HU4 centroid)
processed_resolution_or_use: Same geometries projected with hydrography stack for spatial joins
acquisition_or_storage_mode: National Map / WBD distribution consistent with NHDPlus HR VPU tiling
preprocessing_summary: Centroid spatial joins for catchments; tohuc carried where available; largest-area dedupe for multipart HU polygons
notes: Match WBD edition to the NHDPlus HR vintage used for the same VPU.

dataset_or_layer: PRISM gridded precipitation and temperature (station-grid files for SWAT+)
provider: Oregon State University PRISM Climate Group
role_in_swatgenx: SWAT+ climate station inputs (.pcp/.tmp) and CLI wiring
native_resolution_or_scale: PRISM CONUS grids are commonly distributed on ~4 km cells (see PRISM documentation); code comments reference a 4 km grid in CLI headers
processed_resolution_or_use: Per-cell PRISM extracts compiled into SWAT+ text inputs under model PRISM/ tree
acquisition_or_storage_mode: Reads from operator-local PRISM archives or mirrors (not redistributed by this repository)
preprocessing_summary: Parallel station extract; write r*c*.pcp/.tmp; regenerate tmp.cli and pcp.cli
notes: Record PRISM product vintage and the archive end year used for the evaluation build.

dataset_or_layer: NSRDB gridded solar / humidity / wind drivers (archive-backed extract)
provider: National Renewable Energy Laboratory / NSRDB program
role_in_swatgenx: SWAT+ .slr/.hmd/.wnd station files and CLI lists where enabled
native_resolution_or_scale: Spacing is archive and product dependent; literature discusses multiple NSRDB grid families (commonly ~4 km for PSMSA-era summaries). Legacy internal notes mixed 4 km vs 2 km wording.
processed_resolution_or_use: Station-style series extracted from operator-hosted NSRDB HDF5 archives; not a single asserted universal horizontal spacing in this table
acquisition_or_storage_mode: Large sequential reads from operator-local NSRDB stores
preprocessing_summary: Archive read + parallel extract consistent with SWATGenX NSRDB extractors
notes: Do not cite a single NSRDB grid spacing in manuscript prose until the exact coordinate index / archive build used on the frozen host is recorded.

dataset_or_layer: NLCD land cover (Google Earth Engine export with on-disk fallback)
provider: U.S. Geological Survey (MRLC) / Google Earth Engine
role_in_swatgenx: Land use / land cover rasters for HRU delineation stack
native_resolution_or_scale: NLCD native posting depends on collection (30 m and 250 m paths exist in code)
processed_resolution_or_use: Preferred 30 m NLCD per VPU under NLCD_VPUID_path; may warp 250 m NLCD to a 30 m reference grid when GEE export is unavailable
version_or_snapshot: NLCD 2019 collection (USGS landing metadata cites ver. 3.0; February 2024) per Dewitz2021NLCD bib note
acquisition_or_storage_mode: GEE-authenticated download when available; else reuse/warp on-disk NLCD rasters
notes: GEE export session ids and exact imageCollection assets are audit_required_before_submission.

dataset_or_layer: gSSURGO / SSURGO soils (clipped mapunit grids and tabular attributes)
role_in_swatgenx: Soil map layers and database tables consumed by SWAT+ soil definition workflows
native_resolution_or_scale: Native gSSURGO raster posting is map-unit dependent (commonly 10 m in many CONUS tiles; verify per download)
processed_resolution_or_use: Typically resampled/reprojected to land-surface grid used with QSWAT+ stack (see configuration templates)
acquisition_or_storage_mode: Selective VPU extracts under operator GenXAppData-style trees; not a claim of mirroring the entire national gSSURGO database
preprocessing_summary: Clip to VPU; MAPUNIT joins; reference rasters used as alignment targets for NLCD fallback warping in some branches
notes: Manuscript should describe mapunit + usersoil linkage to SWAT+ expectations—not a full replicated national SSURGO warehouse.

dataset_or_layer: NWIS streamgage catalog context (site metadata; not a gridded layer)
role_in_swatgenx: Outlet semantics and optional QA tables referencing NWIS identifiers
acquisition_or_storage_mode: Public HTTPS NWIS interfaces; small catalog pulls during generation
preprocessing_summary: Catalog-backed helper exports for QA where enabled
notes: Locked evaluation basins use NWIS site_no per evaluation-protocol.md; record pull date if cited.

role_in_swatgenx: Optional crops/ancillary layers when enabled in product configuration
acquisition_or_storage_mode: Only if explicitly enabled for a frozen evaluation case
preprocessing_summary: Omit from claims unless listed in evaluation protocol rows
notes: Not required for Phase 1 structural-only manuscript unless protocol is amended.
